lines.en:
S-Soldiers...  Attack!!
No...  not you...  It couldn't be...?  The prophecy is unraveling...  Uaaaaagggh!!!
Yes.  It's good to be back, Stefan.
lines.zh: 是我。 很高兴回来，斯泰凡。

lines.en: ...  Protagonist???  Why do I see Protagonist...  Have I perished...?
lines.zh: …… Protagonist？？？ 我怎么看到了Protagonist…… 我死了吗……？
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Not quite.  You're doing pretty well, you'll find.
lines.zh: 没呢。 你会发现你活的好好的。

lines.en: What the...  have you lost yer mind, Protagonist?!!  ...  Wait a minute...
lines.zh: 什么…… Protagonist你犯什么毛病？！！…… 等等……

lines.en: Nice trick.  You should probably do it again.
lines.zh: 花招不错。 你应该再来一遍。

lines.en: Protagonist, I have questions...  a chat, please?
lines.zh: Protagonist，我有一个问题…… 能聊聊吗？
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.zh: 斯泰凡…… 我们被选中了……
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: No more running, no more hiding.  The lines are drawn and the enemy has played his hand.  Casamir... the Nephilim have arrived, and we're coming for you.
lines.zh: 我们不会再逃离，不会再躲藏。 战斗已经开始，敌人已经亮出手牌。 圣灵已经降临。卡萨米尔……我们来找你算账了。
